head: Homemade app: DIY beauty and cleaning product recipes step by step
dek: Homemade is a new iPhone app with step-by-step recipes for making everyday products yourself, from lip balm and deodorant to cleaning sprays and candles. It was #40 among free Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 14 November.
details: Each recipe lists what goes in it, which store product it replaces and roughly what it costs to make, with ingredients like castile soap, beeswax, oats, shea butter and essential oils. The download is free, but the recipe library needs Homemade Premium, a yearly subscription that starts with a 7-day free trial. It's made by Homemade Labs and came out on 29 October.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store; free download, recipes need a yearly subscription after a 7-day trial
means: If you'd like to make your own lip balm or cleaning spray, the app gives you the recipe and a rough cost before you start.
todo: If you start the free trial, turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before it ends unless you want to keep paying.
